description: P2-08b reachability check + 2-day schema sample of Bybit's public data dump (spot BTCUSDT) -- a contrast-signal candidate (BLINDSPOT_AUDIT.md #6: 'foreign leads bitFlyer in general' vs 'Binance-specific'), NOT a full data pull. See backtest_data/bybit_reachability_check_20260906/README.md for the full reachability table (spot=monthly-only, trading/perpetual=daily) and the untaken /trading/ schema.
source: https://public.bybit.com/spot/BTCUSDT/BTCUSDT-YYYY-MM.csv.gz (public, unauthenticated, monthly archive only -- no daily files for spot). Two days (2026-08-01, 2026-08-02) sliced out of the 2026-08 monthly file for a schema sample; manually extracted, not via a repo script.
retention: one-off diagnostic sample, not maintained or extended.

timestamp_ms.meaning: exchange timestamp (renamed from the source's bare 'timestamp' to make the unit explicit)

known_defects: not a full P2-08b window pull -- only 2 days for schema confirmation, per the task's explicit scope limit
Bybit spot ships monthly archives only (no daily granularity) -- a full pull would require downloading whole months and slicing, unlike Binance Vision's daily files
the separate /trading/ (USDT perpetual) endpoint IS daily and was reachability-checked but not fetched -- see the README for its schema if it is used later
